sloka: ते स्वामिवचनं वीरा हृदयेष्ववसज्य तत् ।त्वरया ह्यभ्यधावन्त सालतालशिलायुधाः ।। ५.६२.२३ ।।।।
transliteration: te svāmivacanaṁ vīrā hṛdayeṣvavasajya tat ।tvarayā hyabhyadhāvanta sālatālaśilāyudhāḥ ।। 5.62.23 ।।।।

translations.english: The heroic vanaras held Sala and Tala trees and rushed at once keeping their leader's words in mind.
